result.title: Cardiac MRI-informed electrocardiography enables biologically grounded cardiomyopathy detection
result.summary: Precise myocardial phenotyping at population scale is limited by the cost and accessibility of cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR), whereas electrocardiography (ECG) is widely available but reflects electrical rather than structural and functional information. Here we develop MyoECG, a cross-modal representation learning framework that distils myocardial structural and functional knowledge from CMR into standard 12-lead ECGs, enabling imaging-informed cardiomyopathy detection and subtype classification from ECGs alone. MyoECG was pretrained on 45,241 paired ECG-CMR examinations from UK Biobank and a tertiary cardiovascular centre, then developed and validated across more than 1.8 million ECGs from seven independent datasets. Across internal and external datasets spanning prevalences of 0.2-54.7%, MyoECG outperformed five pretrained ECG foundation models, with AUROCs of 0.800-0.974 for cardiomyopathy detection. In a multi-reader study of six cardiologists, MyoECG assistance improved mean sensitivity by 0.109 (95% CI, 0.041-0.175; P = 0.009) and specificity by 0.056 (95% CI, 0.004-0.108; P = 0.040). In 41,128 UK Biobank participants, the MyoECG score showed genetic correlations with cardiomyopathy (rg = 0.409) and dilated cardiomyopathy (rg = 0.371), genome-wide associations at four loci, including regions mapped to NFIA and KCNQ1, and associations with 69 circulating proteins related to myocardial stress, cell adhesion, vascular biology and metabolism. The cardiomyopathy correlation attenuated to non-significance after adjustment for 27 measured CMR traits (rg = 0.131; P = 0.143), indicating that the score captures CMR-derived information rather than dataset-specific shortcuts. MyoECG offers a scalable route to CMR-informed cardiomyopathy assessment and a strategy for transferring knowledge from resource-intensive imaging to widely deployable physiological signals.

AI.brief_summary: 该工作提出 MyoECG，将心脏 MRI 的结构与功能信息跨模态蒸馏进 12 导联 ECG，实现仅凭心电信号的心肌病检测与亚型分类，并在大规模多中心数据与遗传学关联上做了验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 这是面向临床诊断的跨模态表示蒸馏应用，不涉及推理状态生成、潜在表示的使用路径、证据筛选或停止决策，缺少可与 LVR 主线对接的具体机制线索；虽有「把影像信息压缩进受限信号并检验其是否真被使用」的思路，但与多模态推理中的视觉旁路与信息坍缩问题距离过远，暂不纳入。
